running_header_text: ALTO — 146 Scotts Road, Darra — Information Memorandum (Review Draft)
exec_summary_html:
146 Scotts Road, Darra presents a corner commercial strata holding directly opposite Darra Railway Station, in the established Darra town centre. Site photography taken 23 July 2026 confirms an active healthcare and professional tenancy mix trading from the ground floor — A.J. Torbey Solicitors, DDC Specialist Dental Centre, Darra Medical Centre, Ocean Dental Care, and Darra Chemist — supported by solar rooftop infrastructure and dedicated on-site parking.

Asking price is confirmed at $4,500,000 — per Josh, this matches an offer already on file from an overseas (Vietnamese) investor. This figure, and the rent estimate below, originate from ALTO's earlier six-lot marketing of this site (Lots 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 & 8, excluding Shops 4 & 5), previously circulated under the address 39 Railway Parade, Darra QLD 4074 — confirmed by Josh to be the same property. The per-tenant rent shown in the Tenancy Schedule is an estimate, built by matching each of the five current tenants to the closest-matching business in that earlier six-lot schedule by name and use type — it is not a confirmed current rent roll, and one of the six original lots (a second Dental Laboratory unit) could not be matched to any current tenant at all. Confirm the actual current rent roll with Josh before this goes to a purchaser.

property_description_html:
The property comprises a two-storey corner commercial building fronting Scotts Road at a signalised intersection, directly opposite Darra Railway Station. Rooftop solar infrastructure services the building. Ground-floor tenancies front the street with dedicated forecourt parking; a first-floor office suite (Suite 1) is separately fitted for professional use. Total building area is 966m², zoned District Centre (DC1) under Brisbane City Council's planning scheme — a zoning intended for a mix of retail, commercial, health and community uses, consistent with the building's current healthcare/professional tenancy mix.

Executed lease documentation on file for two of the strata shops confirms individual unit areas in the 89.8–90.6m² range, consistent with a multi-tenant strata configuration. This site was previously marketed by ALTO as a six-lot offering (Lots 1, 2, 3, 6, 7 & 8) under the address 39 Railway Parade, Darra QLD 4074 — per Josh, confirmed the same property — at an asking price of $4,500,000, with an offer on file from an overseas investor at that figure. Shops 4 & 5 (Lots 4 & 5, see Historical Lease Reference) were excluded from that six-lot offering and may also be available for inclusion in the sale, for a purchaser looking to acquire the whole site for redevelopment. The address discrepancy between the two marketing documents (146 Scotts Road, 4076 vs. 39 Railway Parade, 4074) has not been independently resolved and should be confirmed with Josh before this goes to a purchaser.

investment_highlights_items_html:
• Asking price confirmed at $4,500,000, matching an offer already on file from an overseas investor
  • Directly opposite Darra Railway Station — rare transit-adjacent commercial holding
  • Established healthcare & professional tenant mix — dental, medical, pharmacy and legal, mirroring the successful positioning of ALTO's earlier six-lot offering for this same site
  • Five active ground-floor tenancies confirmed by current site photography
  • 966m² total building area on a District Centre (DC1) zoning — supports a broad mix of retail, commercial, health and community uses
  • Shops 4 & 5 available as an optional inclusion for purchasers seeking to acquire the whole site for redevelopment
  • Rooftop solar infrastructure already installed
  • Strata-title structure (Title Ref. 15681017) allows flexible future disposal by individual lot
  • Signalised corner exposure with dedicated forecourt parking
  • Healthcare and professional tenancies typically carry high fitout investment and low relocation propensity, supporting tenant retention
investment_highlights_outstanding_note: Outstanding before this IM is finalised: independent confirmation of the current rent roll for all five active tenancies — the figures shown in the Tenancy Schedule are an estimate, mapped from a prior six-lot schedule for a since-turned-over tenant mix, not a confirmed current rent roll (see footnote) — and resolution of the address discrepancy between this site's two marketing documents (146 Scotts Road, 4076 vs. 39 Railway Parade, 4074).
